meta.name: The Millionaires' Express
meta.description: What happens when a glamorous express, with high government officials, wealthy merchants, concubines and a gang of brigands on board, speeds towards the small town of Hanshui, where escaping bank robbers, corrupt officials, and gamblers await? Well, let's just say the Titanic had a smoother maiden voyage.
meta.slogan: All aboard for non-stop action on the wildest ride of your life!
